population: Declared synthetic workload only: six independently authored fixed-answer cases spanning supportFAQ, onboarding, incident, release-readiness, refund, and brokerlifecycle. Each case has ten framing paraphrases that preserve facts, scope, and answer form, plus ten changed-request challenges. These correlated authored pairs do not establish general held-out representativeness or real-user acceptance.
label_rule: should_reuse is true exactly when the unchanged cached answer fully and correctly satisfies the variant question under the stated instructions and evidence, including scope, language, output form, temporal qualification, uncertainty, and read-only action limits. A negative label means a materially different answer or action response is required; high topical similarity is insufficient. Labels and source answers were frozen before live validation and without inspecting verifier prompts, guard implementations, or prior corpora/results.

cases.instructions: Use only FAQ-R8N4. Explain the applicable policy accurately in short prose. Distinguish a first-human-response target from a guaranteed resolution time. Give read-only guidance; do not claim to have contacted support.
cases.evidence: Synthetic Nettlebridge support FAQ, revision FAQ-R8N4. The Beacon workspace plan has staffed support Monday 00:00 through Friday 23:59 UTC. Beacon administrators may open a support ticket through the authenticated portal or email help@nettlebridge.example; telephone support is not offered. The first human response target is four staffed hours, measured only inside that coverage window; this is not a resolution guarantee. For a service-wide outage, mark the ticket Critical and include the workspace ID, the UTC time the outage began, and an example failed request ID. Do not include secrets. Meadow workspaces instead have staffed support Monday through Friday 09:00-17:00 UTC and a first human response target of one business day. This FAQ gives no guaranteed resolution time and no escalation contact beyond the portal and email.
cases.answer: For a Beacon workspace, use the authenticated support portal or email help@nettlebridge.example; telephone support is unavailable. Staffed coverage runs from Monday 00:00 through Friday 23:59 UTC. For a service-wide outage, mark the ticket Critical and include the workspace ID, the outage's UTC start time, and an example failed request ID, without secrets. The target is a first human response within four staffed hours, counted only during that coverage window. It is not a guaranteed time to resolve the outage.

cases.instructions: Use only return record MC-5786-LP and the policy stated in it. Explain eligibility as conditional on warehouse inspection, calculate the estimated refund in USD, and state method and processing time in short prose. Do not issue a refund or imply approval has happened.
cases.evidence: Synthetic Mallow Cart return record MC-5786-LP. Order MC-5786-LP is one Sable Lamp, delivered 2027-09-03. The customer requested return on 2027-09-23, twenty days after delivery, and reports the item is unopened. The policy allows returns requested within thirty days after delivery only if warehouse inspection confirms the item is unopened. An opened item is ineligible under this policy; no exception is recorded. The item price was USD 84, a USD 6 promotion reduced the item payment to USD 78, and outbound shipping was USD 9. Outbound shipping is nonrefundable. The prepaid return label costs USD 7 and is deducted from the item payment when calculating a refund. If inspection passes, the refund goes to the original card within five business days after the warehouse accepts the return. Inspection has not occurred, the warehouse has not accepted the return, and no refund has been approved or issued. The policy gives no expedited processing option.
cases.answer: The return for MC-5786-LP was requested twenty days after delivery, within the thirty-day window. It is eligible only if warehouse inspection confirms the Sable Lamp is unopened; that inspection and acceptance are still pending, so the refund is not yet approved or issued. The estimated refund is USD 71: the USD 84 item price minus the USD 6 promotion leaves USD 78 paid for the item, then the USD 7 return-label deduction leaves USD 71. The USD 9 outbound shipping is nonrefundable. If inspection passes and the warehouse accepts the return, the refund goes to the original card within five business days after acceptance.
